_comment: Registry of independent paper-trading simulations. Each runs its own portfolio/ledger/decision history under state/<id>/. The bot runs every strategy each cycle against one shared market snapshot. cadenceMinutes is documentation of the workflow cron.

strategies.label: Core — semi-long-term
strategies.blurb: EGX30 only. Minimum 5 trading-day holds, ≤2 trades per cycle, low turnover, a few higher-conviction positions. The original strategy.

strategies.label: Swing — active
strategies.blurb: Broad EGX100 universe (~91 liquid names). No minimum hold, ≤3 trades per cycle. Aims for ~+2-3% per position over 1-2 weeks and cuts losers around -3-4%. All exits are the model's call.
